instruction: I want to configure Vim to highlight search results by default. Please look up online how to enable search highlighting in Vim permanently and apply it to my configuration.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)
